data.name: Christin
data.gender_notes: Christin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed one'. The name Christin signifies a person who is devoted to Christ, symbolizing faith, love, and commitment. The name Christin carries the meaning “Follower of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Christin usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Christin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Christ.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Christin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם כריסטין נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'כריסטוס', שפירושה המשוח, ומתייחס לישוע המשיח. השם הוא תרגום של המילה היוונית Χριστός (כריסטוס), שפירושו המשוח. במשמעותו הרחבה, השם כריסטין מייצג את האמונה והקשר לאלוהים במשיחיות.

in_greek.name: Χριστίν
in_greek.meaning: Χριστός, η οποία φέρει το χρίσμα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χριστίν προέρχεται από το ελληνικό Χριστός (Christos), που σημαίνει ο λεχμένος ή ο Μεσσίας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Χριστός αναφέρεται στον Ιησού ως τον Υιόν του Θεού και τον Σωτήρα. Το όνομα Χριστίν συμβολίζει την πίστη και την προσήκωση στον Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Christin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christin derivatur a Graeco Χριστός (Christos), quod significat unctus. In Ecclesia primitiva, Christus fuit titulus Messiae et Salvatoris nostri Iesu Christi. Nomen Christin ergo significat fidem et devotionem ad Christum.

in_english.name: Christin
in_english.meaning: She who is anointed, follower of Christ
in_english.long_meaning: The name Christin originates from the Greek word Χριστός (Christos), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah'. It is associated with Jesus Christ, the Son of God, and represents faith and devotion to him. The name Christin symbolizes the spiritual connection and commitment to Christian values. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its significance in the tradition.
